verdict.rationale: Omarchy provides generic building blocks—Lazygit for git-based versioning/review of config files and omarchy-snapshot for system-wide rollback on updates—but there is no dedicated feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back AI-driven 'automations' specifically. Missing for 10: evidence of an automation-specific change history, agent-run review workflow, or automation-scoped rollback (snapshots are system-wide, not automation-scoped).
